origin.description: Diagonal share, kappa, Rand index, and the corrected Rand index.

arguments.name: tab
arguments.text: A contingency table, rows then columns.

arguments.name: match_names
arguments.text: Match shared dimnames. Left at false here.

origin.details: The default uses the leading square of the table. match.names is not in this check.
origin.example:
ag <- classAgreement(matrix(c(5, 1, 2, 8), 2))
cat(ag$diag, ag$kappa, ag$rand, ag$crand, "\n")
